items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: there was a time when...well, there was this job that we played with Bunk with...I guess it was Al Nicholas on clarinet.

ctx.x: I might have seen her but I don't remember seeing her those years.

Well, she had her followers and when a few people would come in that liked to hear her sing, she'd get up and sing with the band and sang very well. I know I never heard her. There was a time when...well, there was this job that we played with Bunk with...I guess it was Al Nicholas on clarinet. And I'm not clear on the personnel because it started out, I think it was a weekly Saturday night dance thing. Kratka himself sponsored this and we had two trumpets and the rest was standard New Orleans instrumentation.…
But this caravan, those dances were...was Bunk supposed to be there for all of those or was that your band or what was it? I don't remember. Well, uh...it wasn't there.
